audiences.answer: Sundae turns those scattered signals into a ranked decision loop: Pulse catches what is breaking during the shift, Insights explains why margin moved, and Sundae Intelligence answers in plain English with the recommended move and evidence behind it.
audiences.pain: I have data in five different systems. I make most decisions on gut feel because pulling reports takes hours and the answer arrives after the shift is gone.

audiences.answer: Pulse shows every outlet on one screen, ranks what needs attention, routes the next move to the right owner, and lets Benchmark show whether an outlet is actually winning against peers.
audiences.pain: I manage 15 outlets and can't be everywhere. I only find out about problems in the weekly P&L.

audiences.answer: Pulse AI Coach turns live shift signals into coaching prompts, Playbooks route the response, and Scorecard measures whether the manager recovered the shift.
audiences.pain: Our best managers recover slow shifts. Our worst managers watch them happen.

audiences.answer: Insights explains the prime-cost and revenue-assurance drivers behind the P&L, flags voids, discounts, food-cost variance, and labor waste early, and Benchmark shows whether the portfolio is improving against comparable peers.
audiences.pain: I spend 3 days assembling monthly reports from different systems to understand what happened.

audiences.answer: Decision Intelligence platform — not a point solution. Sundae spans the full decision lifecycle: performance reporting, live shift awareness, benchmarking, external market intelligence, deep operational insights, predictive planning, workforce signal, and conversational AI. The investor proof is breadth already translated into commercial readiness, faster deployment, defensible benchmarks, partner leverage, and a product surface operators can use without analysts.
audiences.pain: How is this different from Toast Analytics or Restaurant365?

audiences.answer: Core Foundation is the entry package at $1,195/mo for your first unit, and it already includes the Core domain modules — labour, inventory, purchasing, profit, revenue assurance and the rest — so there is no shopping list to assemble. Growing to a second site adds $175/mo, and each further unit is cheaper than the last as you move down the bands. Workforce-first teams can start on Crew Starter at $99/mo and layer Core on later.
audiences.pain: I can't afford an enterprise system but I need more than my POS dashboard gives me.

differentiators.description: Sundae owns the complete loop — sense, decide, execute, measure, learn — from profit signal to verified recovery, auditable at the level of each individual decision. Each recovery decision is ranked by dollars at stake, assigned to one named owner, executed as one tracked action, proven by baseline reconciliation, and reused as outcome learning. Honesty is the moat: where there is no qualifying signal it produces nothing, and it abstains rather than inflate a number it cannot stand behind. Others report, forecast, recommend or automate parts of the process; only Sundae closes and reconciles the whole loop.
differentiators.title: Closed-loop profit recovery (the lead)

differentiators.description: 12 data domains, six Core intelligence layers, 12 analytics modules, and conversational AI feed one auditable decision — the depth is what makes the closure credible, not a feature list
differentiators.title: Breadth as the evidence network under the loop

differentiators.description: Pulse with 17 sub-pages, 8 exception evaluators, and compound detection (death spiral, leakage drag) — no competitor has same-shift intelligence
differentiators.title: Real-time

differentiators.description: a purpose-built mobile-first PWA, not a responsive squeeze of the desktop — the full Decision Intelligence suite and every Crew operation redesigned for one-handed, glance-and-act use. An answer-first verdict home with persona-configurable pinned KPIs, all 12 Insights modules, 200+ Crew screens, WebAuthn biometric and geofenced clock-in, and opt-in web-push Pulse alerts — installable as a standalone app so operators run the business from their pocket during service, not after it.
differentiators.title: Premium mobile surface

differentiators.description: Benchmark creates a data moat — every new restaurant makes benchmarks more valuable for everyone. This is the STR model that built a $450M business in hotels.
differentiators.title: Network effect

differentiators.description: Sundae Intelligence lets operators ask plain-English questions and get evidence-backed answers without waiting for analysts
differentiators.title: Conversational AI

differentiators.description: four Core packages (Foundation, Margin, Growth, Performance) each bundle the Core domain modules rather than metering them one by one, and every package prices on marginal per-unit bands — the 11th site costs less than the 2nd, and the 51st less again. Operators size the package to the decisions they need, not to a shopping list of add-ons.
differentiators.title: Packaged pricing that rewards scale

differentiators.description: restaurants are the founding vertical; partner and workforce workflows can expand distribution without fragmenting the intelligence layer or losing the operator relationship.
differentiators.title: Expansion architecture

differentiators.description: Sundae does not just surface insight — it acts on it. A cross-channel approve-in-the-loop actuation layer drafts and executes brand-voice review replies, AI-generated social posts, and ad-budget moves (pause/resume/set-budget), plus a conversational + voice agent reachable from Telegram, Slack, Teams, WhatsApp, web mic, or a phone line. A multi-modal actuator posts via the platform API where connected and degrades to a one-click handoff where there is none, so it can act even on channels with no public write API. Every action is logged with its method and outcome and fed back into the intelligence layer — a closed loop point solutions and read-only analytics tools cannot match.
differentiators.title: Action layer (closes the loop)

differentiators.description: scheduling, time & attendance, HR operations, product support, Ask-HR, People Intelligence, and a provider-neutral payroll calculation/readiness/statutory export engine with code-backed GCC, UK/GB, US, Canada, and EU country-pack workflows and export rails shipped. Live filing, bank submission, provider settlement, and jurisdiction production activation remain credential/legal-review gates, not missing product build. Every shift, hour, HR record, and pay-cycle evidence point becomes signal feeding Labor Intelligence, Pulse, Watchtower, and Foresight — a loop a standalone HR/payroll vendor cannot close.
differentiators.title: Operational substrate (Crew)

differentiators.description: a system-wide Data Trust signal (completeness, freshness, connection health, validity, and $-value reconciliation of Sundae net revenue vs the POS source) scores every number on screen and turns silent data gaps into a visible, governed indicator. Foresight adds its own provenance + confidence "why you can trust this" layer. Most analytics tools show numbers without telling operators whether they can be trusted.
differentiators.title: Trust layer

differentiators.description: multi-entity billing routes payment to the correct local legal entity (tax-driven, per-entity Stripe Tax and legal invoicing) with an effective-dated royalty ledger and currency-agnostic FX — so a multi-brand, multi-region operator bills correctly in every market without forking the platform or the data.
differentiators.title: Global-operator commercial rail

differentiators.description: one platform serves ten F&B operator models (three restaurant baselines — group, standalone, café/bakery — plus seven concept models: franchise/multi-brand, hotel F&B, cloud/delivery-first kitchen, catering & events, central kitchen network, rental/ghost commissary, and hybrid F&B group) additively on one topology/RLS/FX spine. Concepts are gated, not forked — an operator adopts a new concept grain (event, production) without a per-vertical rebuild and never loses the connected intelligence layer. A single-concept specialist covers one concept in one or two layers; Sundae covers all six layers across every concept from one spine.
differentiators.title: Multi-concept operator model — six Decision Intelligence layers deep × seven concepts wide
